summary: Feature request, still unimplemented: DXIL defines IMul=41, UMul=42 and UDiv=43 in op class BinaryWithTwoOuts, but no HLSL spelling reaches them -- gen_intrin_main.txt has no entry and the only in-tree emitter is the DXBC-to-DXIL converter. Written the only way HLSL allows, the high half of a 32x32 multiply costs a 64-bit widening and the optional 64-Bit integer feature, while quotient plus remainder remain separate udiv/urem. FXC emits one two-output DXBC udiv from the same source. All 20 stable releases compile the probe and none emits the DXIL op.
title: Support IMul/UMul/UDiv with two outputs from HLSL
